DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 講座の資料について、ご質問ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have a question about the course materials?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。講座では分かったつもりでしたが、家で説明しようとすると忘れます。資料を読む順番より、復習の仕方を相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 講座内容を家庭で説明できず復習方法を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I thought I understood during the course, but I forget when I try to explain it at home. Rather than the order for reading the materials, I would like advice on how to review.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you cannot describe the course content at home and ask about ways to review. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: まず、覚えている内容を短く、ご自身の言葉で書いてみる方法があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: One approach is to first briefly write down what you remember in your own words.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 覚えていることを先に書くのですね。うまく説明できなかった所は、質問としてメモしておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 覚えた内容を書き説明できない所を質問メモにすると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: So I should write what I remember first. I will note down anything I could not explain well as a question.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you will write what you remember and make question notes about what you cannot explain. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 次回に聞きたいこととして、まとめておくとよいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: It would be good to organize those as things to ask next time.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 「説明できたこと」と「まだ聞きたいこと」に分けてみます。次回、そのメモを持って来てもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 二種類に分けた復習メモを次回持参してよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will separate them into 'things I could explain' and 'things I still want to ask.' May I bring those notes next time?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask whether you may bring review notes divided into two categories next time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、担当へお見せください。家で誰かに説明してみると、質問したい所が見つかることもあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes, please show them to the person in charge. Trying to explain the content to someone at home may also help you find things you want to ask.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 家族に短く話します。家族が質問した所は、私が覚えていない所かもしれないので、次回の質問に加えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 家族へ説明し質問された所を次回質問にする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will give my family a short explanation. The parts they ask about may be things I have not remembered, so I will add them to my questions for next time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain the content to your family and make the parts they ask about into questions for next time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 質問の受付方法は、講座の担当へ確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please check with the course representative how questions are accepted.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 確認します。今日は資料を増やすのではなく、今ある内容を自分で説明して復習するところから始めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 受付方法を聞き資料追加より既習自己説明から始める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will. Today, rather than getting more materials, I will start by reviewing the content I already have through explaining it myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask how to submit questions and begin by explaining what you have learned yourself rather than adding materials. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ぜひ試してみてください。それでは、次回もお待ちしています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please give it a try. We look forward to seeing you next time.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 見え方を確認する前に、何か伝えることはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Before we check your vision, is there anything you need to tell us?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 普段は眼鏡を使っていますが、今日は家に忘れて来ました。裸眼のままでも、予定していた確認はできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 眼鏡を忘れ裸眼で予定の確認ができるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I usually wear glasses, but I left them at home today. Can the planned check still be done with my unaided eyes?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you forgot your glasses and ask whether the planned check can be done without them. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 普段の使用について、測定担当へ伝えます。今日はコンタクトレンズをお使いですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will tell the examiner about your usual use of glasses. Are you wearing contact lenses today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: コンタクトも使っていません。今日は裸眼です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: コンタクト未使用で裸眼と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I am not wearing contacts either. My eyes are unaided today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you are not wearing contact lenses and your eyes are unaided. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: どのような確認ができるか、担当がご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: The examiner will explain what checks can be done.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。眼鏡がないと小さい表示はよく見えません。見えない時は、そのまま伝えていいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 小さい表示が見えにくいと報告し回答方法を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Thank you. Without my glasses I cannot see small signs well. When I cannot see something, may I just say so?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Report difficulty seeing small signs and confirm how to answer. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、実際の見え方をお答えください。確認の方法は担当が説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes, please report how you actually see. The examiner will explain the check procedure.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。家へ取りに戻る必要があるかも、今決めずに担当の案内を聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 眼鏡取戻要否を担当確認後に判断したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: All right. I would also like to hear the examiner's guidance before deciding whether I need to go home to get my glasses.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you want to decide whether to retrieve your glasses after checking with the examiner. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 今日の確認内容と、その後の案内を担当へご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please discuss today's checks and the subsequent guidance with the examiner.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 普段は眼鏡、今日は裸眼ともう一度伝えます。結果の説明を聞く時も、その違いを確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 普段眼鏡今日裸眼を再説明し結果条件も確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will tell them again that I usually wear glasses but my eyes are unaided today. When hearing the explanation of the results, I will also confirm that difference.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain again that you usually wear glasses but are unaided today, and also confirm the conditions for the results. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 測定担当へご案内します。それでは、こちらでお待ちください。お大事になさってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will direct you to the examiner. Please wait here. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 今日の説明について、何かご質問はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have any questions about today's explanation?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家族にも話したいですが、被害が必ず起こると言って怖がらせたくありません。注意点だけ落ち着いて伝えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 家族へ必発被害で脅さず注意を伝えたいと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want to tell my family too, but I do not want to scare them by saying harm will definitely happen. I want to calmly explain just the precautions.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about conveying precautions to your family without frightening them by claiming harm is inevitable. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 気になった場面を、ご自身の言葉で説明してみてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Try explaining a situation that concerned you in your own words.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 知らない人が訪ねて来ても、すぐドアを開けずに相手を確認するという話です。家でも確認の仕方を決めたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 来訪者確認の説明を家での対応相談につなげる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: It was about checking who is there without immediately opening the door when a stranger visits. I would like us to decide how to check at home too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Connect the explanation about checking visitors to discussing how to respond at home. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 家族と対応を相談する形なら、話し合いやすいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: It should be easier to talk if you discuss how to respond with your family.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 「誰が応対するか、相手が分からない時はどうするか、一緒に決めよう」と話してみます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 家族と役割と対応を決める言い方を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will try saying, 'Let's decide together who will answer and what to do when we do not know who the visitor is.'
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show how to suggest deciding roles and responses with your family. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 具体的なご心配があれば、別に相談できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: If you have a specific concern, you can consult us separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今、被害を受けたという相談ではありません。説明を聞いて家族と決めたいことができた、と分けて伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 現在被害報告と一般説明後の家庭相談を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I am not asking for help because I have suffered harm now. I will distinguish that from saying that after hearing the explanation, I found things I want to decide with my family.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Distinguish reporting current harm from a family discussion following general guidance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 案内も、ご家族と読んでいただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: You can also read the information with your family.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 案内を持ち帰って家族と読みます。まず、玄関での対応を一つずつ相談してみます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 案内を持ち帰り玄関での対応を家族と確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will take the information home and read it with my family. First we will discuss how to respond at the front door, one point at a time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Take the information home and confirm front-door responses with your family. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どうぞご家族でご相談ください。それでは、お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please discuss it with your family. Have a safe trip home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 父に切手を買って来てと言われました。父は集めるのが好きなので、手紙に使う物か、絵を楽しむ物か確認してから選びたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 父の切手収集用か郵送用か確認後選びたいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: My father asked me to buy stamps. He likes collecting them, so I want to check whether they are for mailing letters or enjoying the pictures before choosing.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you want to choose after checking whether your father's stamps are for collecting or mailing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 用途やご希望の絵柄によって、選び方が違いますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: The choice depends on the purpose and the designs he likes.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。額だけ聞いて買うと、父の希望と違うかもしれません。今ここから電話して聞いてもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 額だけで選ばず電話許可を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. If I buy based only on the face value, I may not get what he wants. May I call him from here now to ask?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Avoid choosing based only on face value and ask permission to call. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 通路を空けた所で、どうぞご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please check in a spot where you leave the walkway clear.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 聞けました。今日は使わずに眺めたいので、花の絵がある物がよいそうです。展示の花の物を見せてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 観賞用花希望を本人確認し提示依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have asked him. He wants to look at them rather than use them today, so he would like ones with flower pictures. Please show me the flower stamps on display.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm with your father that he wants flower stamps for viewing and ask to see them. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらの花の切手がございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: We have these flower stamps here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 父が選ぶため、名称を読み上げて伝えます。こちらの切手は何という名前で案内されていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 本人選択のため商品名称を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will read out the name to my father so he can choose. What name are these stamps listed under?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask the product name so your father can make the choice himself. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 「春の花」です。こちらの説明もご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: They are called 'Spring Flowers.' Please read this description too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 「春の花」と伝えたら、父もこれがいいと言いました。一組お願いします。折れないように持って帰りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 父が選んだ切手一組を注文し折れない持帰り方を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: When I told him 'Spring Flowers,' he said he wanted these. One set, please. I would like to take them home without bending them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Order one set of the stamps your father chose and ask about taking them home without bending them. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 厚紙を添えてお渡しします。それでは、お買い上げありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will include a piece of stiff card. Thank you for your purchase.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご案内は以上です。次へ進めてもよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: That concludes the information. May we move on?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 少し待ってください。今聞いた日付を、忘れないうちに自分の手帳へ書きたいです。急いで次へ進むと混ざりそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 説明終了前日付メモの時間を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Please wait a moment. I want to write the date I just heard in my own planner before I forget. If we rush on, I think I will mix things up.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for time to note the date before the explanation finishes. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どうぞお書きください。どの日付をもう一度確認されますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please write it down. Which date would you like to confirm again?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 次に連絡する予定の日です。支払う日と同じだと思わず、何の日かも横に書きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 支払日と混ぜず連絡予定日として確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: The date of the next planned contact. Rather than assuming it is the same as the payment date, I want to write what the date is for beside it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm it as the planned contact date without confusing it with the payment date. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 今日は、次の連絡予定としてお伝えしました。お支払いの案内は別に確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Today, I gave it as the next planned contact date. Please confirm the payment information separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 次の連絡予定、と書きます。日付をもう一度読み上げてもらえますか。数字だけでなく月から確かめたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 月から日付復唱を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will write 'next planned contact.' Could you read the date out again? I want to check from the month, not just the numbers.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask for the date to be repeated starting with the month. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 四月十日です。次の連絡の予定としてご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: It is April tenth. Please confirm it as the date of the next planned contact.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 四月十日、次の連絡予定と書きました。私から連絡するか、連絡を待つかも決めずにいたので、そこを聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 四月十日記録後自己発信か待受か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I wrote 'April tenth, next planned contact.' I also had not settled whether I should contact you or wait to be contacted, so I would like to ask about that.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: After noting April tenth, ask whether you should initiate contact or wait. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当からの連絡をお待ちいただく予定です。ご事情が変わった時の連絡先もご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: The plan is for you to wait for the representative to contact you. I will also provide a contact for when your circumstances change.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 担当の方からの連絡を待つ、と追記しました。事情が変わった時の連絡先も、この手帳へ書きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 担当からの連絡待ちと記録し変更時の連絡先も書きたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I added 'wait for contact from the representative.' I would like to write the contact details for a change in circumstances in this planner too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Record that you will wait for the representative's contact, and say you also want to note the contact for changes in circumstances. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こちらの案内に担当窓口と連絡先を載せています。お持ち帰りください。本日のご案内は以上です。それでは、失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: This information sheet lists the responsible desk and contact details. Please take it home. That concludes today's information. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お会計にお進みですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you heading to the checkout?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: その前にお伝えします。子どもが、かごのお菓子の袋を開けてしまいました。まだ食べていませんが、そのまま棚へ戻しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 子の会計前開封を申告し返棚しないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Before that, I need to tell you something. My child opened a bag of snacks in the basket. They have not eaten any yet, but I will not put it back on the shelf as it is.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report that your child opened a product before checkout and say you will not return it to the shelf. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 商品を確認します。どの袋でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will check the product. Which bag is it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この袋です。角のところを開けましたが、食べてはいません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 開封箇所と未飲食を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: This bag. They opened the corner, but have not eaten any.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain where it was opened and that nothing has been consumed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらの商品について、ご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will explain what to do about this product.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。子どもには会計まで待つように話して、ここで一緒に待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 子に会計まで待つと伝え一緒に待機する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. I will tell my child to wait until checkout, and we will wait here together.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Tell your child to wait until checkout and wait together. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 一緒にこちらでお待ちください。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。中身は今のところ出ていません。開いた口を上にして持っておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 中身が出ていないと報告し口を上にして保持する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: All right. None of the contents have come out so far. I will hold it with the opening facing upward.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Report that none of the contents have come out and hold it with the opening upward. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認できました。この袋のままレジでお会計できます。お持ち帰りには新しい袋をご用意します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: I have checked it. You can pay at the register with the bag as it is. We will provide a new bag for taking it home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: では、この商品の代金を払います。開いた袋を入れる袋もお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 当該商品の会計と持帰り袋を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Then I will pay for this product. Please also give me a bag to put the opened bag in.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask to pay for that product and for a bag to take it home. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。袋もレジでお渡しします。それでは、お会計へどうぞ。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. We will give you the bag at the register too. Please proceed to checkout. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 休憩場所について、お尋ねですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you asking about a place to rest?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。歩く速さが少し速くて疲れました。友人も一緒なので、二人で座って休める場所を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 歩き疲れ友人と二人着席休場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. We walked a little too fast and I am tired. My friend is with me, so please tell us where we can both sit and rest.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you are tired from walking and ask where you and your friend can both sit and rest. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: あちらのベンチをご利用いただけます。通路から少し離れています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: You can use that bench over there. It is a little away from the walkway.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: あちらですね。友人も疲れているので、二人でベンチへ移ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: ベンチ位置を確認し友人と移ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Over there, right? My friend is tired too, so we will both move to the bench.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm where the bench is and say you will move there with your friend. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 近くに水飲み場もございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: There is also a drinking fountain nearby.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 水飲み場もあるのですね。休んでから飲みに行きたいので、場所を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 休憩後に使う水飲み場の位置を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: There is a drinking fountain too, then. I would like to go and drink after resting, so please tell me where it is.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask the location of the drinking fountain you will use after resting. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 水飲み場は、ベンチの先の案内板の横です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: The drinking fountain is beside the information board beyond the bench.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 案内板の横ですね。友人が水を取りに行くなら、私はベンチにいると伝え、場所を変えず待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 水場位置復唱し友人外出時はベンチ待機と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Beside the information board, understood. If my friend goes to get water, I will tell them I am staying at the bench and wait without moving elsewhere.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Repeat the fountain location and say you will wait at the bench if your friend goes away. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お手伝いが必要な時は、こちらへお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please let us know here if you need help.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。少し座ってから、散歩を続けるか二人で相談します。まずはゆっくりベンチへ行きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 休後続行帰宅を相談し今はゆっくりベンチへ行く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. After sitting for a while, we will discuss whether to continue our walk. For now, we will walk slowly to the bench.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Discuss whether to continue or go home after resting, and go slowly to the bench for now. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どうぞ無理なさらずお休みください。それでは、お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23228-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please rest without pushing yourselves. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ベンチの方で、何かありましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Did something happen at the bench?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 座ったらズボンの後ろがぬれました。立って見たら、座面にも水のような物が残っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 着席後ズボン濡れと座面液体残存を報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: When I sat down, the back of my trousers got wet. After standing up and looking, I saw something like water still on the seat too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report wet trousers after sitting and liquid remaining on the seat. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 場所を教えていただけますか。今は、そのベンチから離れていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Could you show me where? Are you away from that bench now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: あちらの端の席です。今は離れて立っています。まだそこへ座った人はいません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 端席を示し離れて立ち後続着席者なしと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: The end seat over there. I have moved away and am standing now. No one else has sat there yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Point out the end seat, explain that you are standing away from it, and that no one has sat there since. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらで確認します。ご自身が飲み物をこぼされたのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will check it. Did you spill a drink yourself?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 私は飲み物を持っていません。座る前からあったかまでは見ていないので、誰がこぼしたとは言えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 自己飲物不所持だが液体発生者時点を断定できないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I do not have a drink. I did not check whether it was there before I sat down, so I cannot say who spilled it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you had no drink yourself, but cannot establish who caused the liquid or when. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご自身で触って調べず、その場所を空けておいてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please do not touch it to investigate yourself, and leave that spot clear.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 触らずに待ちます。あちらの端の席ですね。ほかの人が座ろうとしたら、ぬれていると声をかけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 座面を触らず場所を確認し着席しようとする人へ知らせると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will wait without touching it. It is the end seat over there. If anyone tries to sit, I will tell them it is wet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm the location without touching the seat, and say you will warn anyone who tries to sit there. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 職員が確認して対応します。おけがや、痛みはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: A staff member will check and handle it. Are you injured or in any pain?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: けがも痛みもありません。服がぬれたことと、座面の位置を伝えたかったです。確認する方が来るまで、近くで場所を示せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: けが痛みなしで濡れと場所を担当へ示せると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have no injury or pain. I wanted to report that my clothes got wet and where the seat is. I can stay nearby to point it out until the person checking it arrives.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say there is no injury or pain and you can show the staff the wet seat's location. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お知らせありがとうございます。それでは、ベンチを確認してまいります。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for letting us know. I will go and check the bench. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 子育てについて、ご相談をご希望ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like a consultation about raising your child, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。子どものことで相談したいですが、初めては私だけで来てもよいでしょうか。子どもは学校にいる時間です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 子どもの相談初回に親のみ来所できるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I would like to discuss my child, but may I come alone the first time? My child will be at school during that time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether only the parent may come for the first consultation about a child. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 相談の内容と担当によって確認が必要です。お困りのことを、差し支えない範囲で教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: We need to check depending on the topic and the person in charge. Please tell us what is troubling you, as far as you feel comfortable sharing.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 学校から帰ると、友達とうまく話せないと言っています。まず私から普段の様子を説明したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 子の友人会話の困りと親から日常説明希望を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: When my child comes home from school, they say they cannot talk well with their friends. I would like to explain their everyday behavior myself first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Describe the child's difficulty talking with friends and the parent's wish to explain everyday behavior first. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その希望を担当へ伝え、初回の相談方法を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will tell the representative your preference and confirm how the first consultation will be conducted.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 家で本人が話したことと、私が見た様子を分けてメモしてあります。担当の方にそのメモを見てもらいたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 子の発言と親の観察を分けたメモを担当へ提示したいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have made notes separating what my child said at home from what I observed. I would like the representative to read those notes.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you want to show the representative notes separating the child's statements from the parent's observations. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご相談できる時間も伺います。学校にいる間の時間をご希望でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: May I also ask what times you can attend? Would you prefer while your child is at school?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい、午前中なら一人で来られます。もし本人も必要なら、学校を休ませる前に別の日を相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 午前希望し子の来所必要時は欠席前に別日相談と話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes, I can come alone in the morning. If my child needs to come too, I will discuss another date before keeping them out of school.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: State a preference for the morning and say you will discuss another date before a school absence if the child must attend. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当から、来所者と予約の案内をお伝えします。連絡できる番号をご用意ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: The representative will explain who should attend and how to book. Please have a phone number ready where we can reach you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: この番号で連絡を受けます。私だけで来るつもりだと先に伝え、案内を聞いてから日を決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 自己番号を提示し来所者案内後に予約日を決めると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I can receive calls on this number. I will explain in advance that I intend to come alone, and decide the date after hearing the guidance.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Give your number and say you will choose a booking date after receiving guidance on who should attend. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、担当へ確認いたします。こちらでお待ちください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will check with the representative. Please wait here. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 診察の準備で、着替えていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Could you change your clothes in preparation for the examination?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。ただ、床のかばんが足元にあって動きづらいです。腰が痛くてかがめないので、椅子へ移してもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 腰痛でかがめず床かばんを椅子へ移す援助を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. But my bag on the floor is at my feet and makes it difficult to move. My lower back hurts and I cannot bend down, so could you move it onto a chair?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for help moving a bag from the floor to a chair because lower-back pain prevents you from bending down. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらの椅子へ移します。中に、すぐ使う物はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will move it onto this chair. Is there anything inside that you need right away?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 診察券と薬のメモは手に持っています。かばんの中を開ける必要はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 診察券薬メモは所持し荷物開封不要と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I am holding my patient card and medication notes. There is no need to open the bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you have your patient card and medication notes and the bag does not need to be opened. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: かばんは閉じたまま置きました。着替える際、立つ時のお手伝いも必要ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: I put the bag down still closed. When changing, will you also need help standing up?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: まず座って上の服を替えたいです。立つ前に痛みの様子を見て、必要なら声をかけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 座位から着替え起立前に痛みを見て声掛けすると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: First, I would like to change my top while sitting. Before standing up, I will check how the pain feels and call for help if needed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will start changing while seated, check your pain before standing, and ask for help if needed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お使いになった服は、かばんの上ではなくこちらへ置いてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please put the clothes you have taken off here, rather than on top of the bag.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この台へ服を置きます。足元が空いたので、座ったまま上の服を替えてみます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 指定台へ服を置き足元が空いた状態で座って着替えると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will put my clothes on this stand. Now the space at my feet is clear, I will try changing my top while remaining seated.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will put clothes on the designated stand and change while sitting with the space at your feet cleared. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 準備ができたら、こちらの呼出しボタンでお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: When you are ready, please let us know using this call button.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 着替えられました。まだ座っています。ボタンを押して知らせるので、診察担当の方に来てもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 座ったままの着替え完了を伝えボタンで診察担当を呼びたいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have finished changing. I am still sitting. I will press the button to let you know, so could the examination staff come here?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Report that you have finished changing while still seated and want to call the examination staff with the button. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、診察の担当へお伝えします。こちらでお待ちください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-23229-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will tell the examination staff. Please wait here. Excuse me.
